verses.text: He . . . heard a voice say to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
verses.title: You Do It to Me

verses.text: Restore to me the joy of your salvation and grant me a willing spirit, to sustain me.
God is not unjust; he will not forget your work and the love you have shown him as you have helped his people and continue to help them.
